description: MainThrive MAI-1427. This config exists so that the upstream pin in .github/workflows/build.yml is proposed when upstream moves. Before it nothing did, and MainThrive MAI-1424 found the pin far behind upstream by hand.
enabledManagers is only the regex manager below, on purpose. This repo's job is one upstream plus our patches; the action SHAs in the workflows are not what this config is for.

automerge is false and must stay false. A bump means rebasing our patches onto the new upstream and bumping VERSION, and the build refuses a changed input without a VERSION bump. So a proposal is red until a person does that work, and a person reviews it.
There is no minimumReleaseAge. The git datasources publish no release timestamps, so a soak would hold every release forever (MainThrive MAI-1424 measured that failure on quay.io and ghcr.io).
Upstream publishes no tags, so the pin is a commit on main (RELAY_SHA). The git-refs datasource follows main and proposes its newest commit.
